motion.name: native-scroll-photo-step
motion.purpose: Hold half a step, then reversible linear crossfade for the second half; final photo has a full pinned step. Focus, reduced motion and insufficient fit retain accessible fallbacks.

motion.name: shared-seasonal-year
motion.purpose: Hero and visible sequenced narrative photos share one clock; exact nested source-over dissolve inside scroll blend. Masthead dial pauses/resumes; ≤500px height uses bottom dock. Hidden, print, dialog, reduced-motion and save-data states preserve originals.

motion.name: privacy-notice-collapse
motion.purpose: Focus/hover cancels dismissal; reduced motion skips animation. Presentation only, never tracking authorization.

narrative.overview: House colors frame real property photography and uninterrupted Georgia prose. Persistent address/contact access and compact Arial facts support a quiet, photo-led walk through the home. The owner-pinned composition is implemented in `index.html` and `gallery.html`, not a conventional listing mosaic.
keyCharacteristics: Full-width photographs and alternating, heading-free narrative.
House-color fields, square controls and fine rules; no shadows.
Native scrolling with fit-aware inline fallbacks.

rules.name: The House Palette Rule
rules.body: These are screen approximations of the owner's Debonair, Accessible Beige, Sea Salt, Greek Villa, dark mahogany solid stain and Cabot red-tinted semi-solid stain, not physical paint-match specifications. The cedar token approximates the red-stain accent; no exact Cabot product/shade is established. Current dark mahogany wording is not a claim of identity with the dated Traditional Mahogany purchase record. Pewter Green remains historical door paint, not a required website anchor; Greek Villa is a named house color, not a generic cream mandate. CSS aliases resolve forest to dark mahogany, paper to Greek Villa, paper-strong to Accessible Beige and rule to stone.

rules.name: The Native Scroll Rule
rules.body: Native scroll position directly controls reversible crossfades between captioned photographs; scrolling is never captured. On desktop the whole narrative stage sticks below header and facts plus 24px; on mobile only the photo sequence sticks, with 16px clearance after the paragraph. Steps are `max(240px, half the viewport height)`: hold for the first half, blend for the second. The final photo receives a full pinned step after its blend completes. The tallest caption reserves a stable frame; at most two photos blend. Only the images blend: complementary link opacities use `plus-lighter` inside an isolated, transparent photo group, so overlap stays fully covered and unequal contain-fit edges fade to the section color without a background pulse (colonial-y9y). Seasonal layers remain source-over inside each isolated link. Scroll timing stays directly linear; no timed catch-up or easing was added. The dominant photo owns the readable, unblended caption, highlighted dot, interaction and accessibility state. A focused photo stays fully visible until focus leaves, then scroll state resumes.

dos: Do preserve the seven approved paragraphs, exact captions, watermarks and conceptual-plan disclosure.
Do keep contact access, visible keyboard focus and ordinary links available.
Do use the existing system fonts, static assets and dependency-free enhancement.
Do keep buyer styling and retained historical image assets intact when pruning unrelated routes.
donts: Don't replace the approved composition with a mosaic, story headings, Home / Photos navbar or closing contact band.
Don't crop property evidence with cover-fit or present the conceptual plan as existing finished space.
Don't intercept scrolling, add timed autoplay outside the seasonal dissolves or parallax, or remove reduced-motion and short-screen fallbacks.
